claims.claim: Q2 revenue was about $178M, up about 9% sequentially, while material-handling deployments more than doubled year over year to 1,666 GenDrive units.
Two large customers plan to refresh more than 20,000 GenDrive units over three years, indicating a potentially reusable installed-base demand channel.

risks.risk: Hydrogen economics and capital intensity remain major execution constraints despite improving unit/service economics.

unknowns.unknown: Customer refresh plans are prospective and conversion timing is not assured.

claims.claim: Gross margin was approximately break-even, operating expenses fell about 50% year over year to about $62M, and net cash usage was about $61M.
Service revenue grew 82% year over year to about $30M with a positive 27% service margin, evidencing improving installed-base economics.

risks.risk: Break-even gross margin is a milestone, not yet proof of durable consolidated profitability or self-funding operations.

contradictions.contradiction: Operational and margin improvement coexists with continued net cash consumption.

unknowns.unknown: Path and timing to durable positive free cash flow remain unproven.
